_readme: Which row of the paradata (src/data/paradata.json) each part of the 3D scene shows in the 'measured or guessed' view. A part's id is set as userData.paradata on its object, or per vertex in the merged meshes (src/world/paradataTags.js). 'decision' is the row whose element describes the part most closely; its status is the one shown. null: no row in paradata_3 covers the part; then 'status' (measured, inferred, invented or omitted), where given, is the reconstructor's record of the part in PROGRESS.md, named in 'why', until a row is added to the Sheet (asked for on 18 November 2026: the stairs, the Room 4 changes, the screen sizes and the works); with no 'status' the view shows it as 'not recorded'. 'size' records a work's or screen's size where it is known. 'why' says which row was chosen and why. The choice of row is the assistant's (17 November 2026) and waits for the reconstructor's check.

The street wall with its niches, windows, the two radiators under them, the vent and the heating pipe (Room 1 street wall).
The wall between Rooms 1 and 2: piers, recess, doorway and the two plinths (Room 1 to Room 2 doorway).
Floor: the traced plan (Floor plan).
No row gives the ceiling's height.

PROGRESS.md, Decision 1 and 1b (17 and 18 November 2026): 8 risers, the bottom one 0.12 m, the landing at 1.24 m running through the west wall to the closed street door, two-tone treads, the chairs on the stairs left out; from DSC_0014 to DSC_0016 and S34 (room_1_stairs_important.webp, main_entrance.webp). The door opening's sides and head are invented. No row in paradata_3 yet (the shaft row ap-d12 no longer applies: the shaft was taken out).
The bench (Furniture).
